title: Minnesota Fraud Research Relationship
description: Directed evidence-backed edge between two entity, claim, case, or source IDs. CRITICAL: a shared address is NOT conspiracy. SHARES_ADDRESS_WITH must be stored and displayed as a shared address. Do not transform it into a 'connected fraud network' unless independent evidence supports that conclusion. Likewise common attorney, accountant, employee, ethnic community, neighborhood, bank, program, or vendor are not automatically evidence of conspiracy. relationship_status distinguishes observed relationship from analytical inference from criminal allegation from adjudicated criminal relationship. Every relationship must resolve back to evidence.

relationship_id.description: Durable identifier. Never use a display name as a key.

relationship_status.description: OBSERVED = documented non-criminal or structural fact (e.g. registered agent, shared address). ALLEGED = asserted in a charging instrument or similar. ANALYTICAL_INFERENCE = derived by the research system and must be labeled as such. ADJUDICATED = established by plea, verdict, or final judgment.
